# WeChat Market Pulse

Local WeChat 4.x group conversations and images to evidence-linked Chinese briefing PNGs.
Windows/macOS Python package. Cloud, OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, LM Studio/vLLM and deterministic rules backends.

- [README](README.md): features and quick start
- [Agent guide](docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md): ordered setup, JSON interface and troubleshooting
- [Installation](docs/INSTALL.md): prerequisites, account access and offline import
- [Models](docs/MODELS.md): cloud/local/no-LLM configuration and limitations
- [Delivery](docs/DELIVERY.md): original-file Taildrop and optional owner-bound ClawBot
- [Validation](docs/VALIDATION.md): tested platforms and actual limits
- [Security](SECURITY.md): private data and source boundaries
- [Third party](THIRD_PARTY.md): source revisions and licenses
- [Synthetic transcript](examples/messages.jsonl): import format
